answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 28 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in mirror, verified in voyage, and anchor names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 430 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
